# RAR fixtures

`rar5-crc.rar` and `rar3-comment-plain.rar` are test fixtures from
[markokr/rarfile](https://github.com/markokr/rarfile/tree/master/test/files).
The upstream ISC license is retained in `LICENSE.rarfile`.

RAR3 covers directory parsing. RAR5 covers retained directory entries and readable
member contents; compressed-member availability depends on the host decoder.
